messages:
Ana (platform PM): Quick sync — can folks share short status on the console observability roadmap items? Specifically: dashboards for latency/cost by route, tracing hooks rollout, error-analysis views, and retention milestone (who owns the 90->180d decision).
Sam (SRE): I can cover retention + tracing hooks. retention proposal PR is up: https://git.redwood/infra/trace-retention/pull/82. Main blocker is storage sizing from infra.
Jia (frontend): Dashboards — most widgets are ready in staging. Need final metric names from runtime team (kv_cache_hit_rate, token_latency_p50/p95). Waiting on Mike to confirm.
Mike (runtime): Confirmed. metric names are kv_cache_hit_ratio, token_latency_p50, token_latency_p95. I'll push a tiny rename patch by EOD.
Nadia (product): From product, we want error-analysis views to show top failing endpoints + sample prompts (for regressions). Who owns the sample anonymization?
Sam (SRE): Ownership: infra retains raw traces, but the console team owns scrub/anonymize pipeline pre-view. I can add sam@ to the PR for the anonymization spec.
Ana (platform PM): Great. Can we get owners and milestones in one place? Suggest a small table: item / owner / blocker / milestone date. I'll create a quick doc unless someone has a better repo.
Jia (frontend): Put it in the obs-roadmap doc under docs/console/obs. I can add dashboard tasks.
Mike (runtime): Blocker for tracing hooks: we still have an intermittent race when reattaching KV cache metadata. Patch in runtime: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/459 — needs one more review from eng-platform.
Sam (SRE): I'll review PR-459 today. If it lands, tracing hook rollout to prod can be staged next week (canary on 10% traffic).
Nadia (product): Milestones: dashboards in prod by 2026-04-10, tracing hooks canary by 2026-04-17, error-analysis MVP by 2026-04-24. OK to use these as targets?
Ana (platform PM): Those look good. Sam/Mike/Jia, can you confirm owners for each? I'll put into the doc and tag all.
Mike (runtime): Owner: runtime team (me) for tracing hooks; blocker is PR review + perf test pass.
Jia (frontend): Owner: frontend for dashboard implementation and wiring to metrics.
Sam (SRE): Owner: infra/sre for retention decision & anonymization pipeline. I'll set up a short meeting Tues 11am to finalize sizing + retention (90/180).
Ana (platform PM): Thanks. Quick follow-ups: 1) Sam — please add the retention math to the PR description. 2) Jia — after Mike's rename patch, update widget queries. 3) Nadia — send sample anonymization policy for legal review.
Sam (SRE): Will do. Added a checklist to the PR.
Jia (frontend): Noted. I'll hold off on prod deploy until metric rename lands.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted a deploy notice: staging-dashboard-v2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-22T15:02:12Z :rocket:
Ana (platform PM): Awesome. I'll open the doc and tag everyone. If no objections, we'll treat the milestone dates as tentative commitment. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Mike (runtime): No objections from runtime side.
Nadia (product): 👍 moving forward.
